definitions.gloss: to guide; to show around; to lead
definitions.explanation: To lead someone to a place or show them around, acting as a guide.

definitions.gloss: to inform; to notify; to announce
definitions.explanation: To provide information or directions, often in an official or service context.

examples.japanese: {部屋|へや}に{案内|あんない}した。
examples.english: I showed them to the room.

examples.japanese: {観光客|かんこうきゃく}を{京都|きょうと}の{寺|てら}に{案内|あんない}した。
examples.english: I guided the tourists to the temples in Kyoto.

examples.japanese: {初|はじ}めて{来|き}た{友人|ゆうじん}を{街|まち}の{名所|めいしょ}に{案内|あんない}して{回|まわ}った。
examples.english: I showed my friend who was visiting for the first time around the famous spots in town.

examples.japanese: {詳|くわ}しくは{窓口|まどぐち}で{案内|あんない}します。
examples.english: We will provide details at the counter.

examples.japanese: {新|あたら}しいサービスについてメールで{案内|あんない}した。
examples.english: We informed customers about the new service by email.

examples.japanese: {席|せき}が{空|あ}き{次第|しだい}、{順番|じゅんばん}に{案内|あんない}いたしますので、しばらくお{待|ま}ちください。
examples.english: We will seat you in order as tables become available, so please wait a moment.

notes:
A versatile word used both for physically guiding someone and for providing information. Very common in service and hospitality contexts.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {道|みち}を{案内|あんない}する: to show the way
- {席|せき}に{案内|あんない}する: to show to a seat
- ご{案内|あんない}: guidance, information (polite)
- {案内|あんない}{所|じょ}: information desk
- {案内|あんない}{図|ず}: guide map
- {案内|あんない}{状|じょう}: invitation letter

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {導|みちび}く: to lead — more literary, implies guidance toward a goal
- {紹介|しょうかい}する: to introduce — focuses on introducing people or things
- {説明|せつめい}する: to explain — focuses on verbal explanation rather than guiding
